endorsements.name: Cristian Bejan
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-0918
endorsements.description: The SMTP for SendGrid – YaySMTP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 1.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.2)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Cristian Bejan
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1267
endorsements.description: The Groundhogg plugin for Wordpress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the ‘label' parameter in versions up to, and including, 3.7.4.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Administrator-level access, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This only affects multi-site installations and installations where unfiltered_html has been disabled.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.5)
